text_block_list.text: —Our second summer training camp had also come to an end.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "All that's left is to head straight for the Sprinters Stakes."
choice_data_list: Let's take a victory worthy of a King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, naturally.
What else could it possibly be?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Waaow, as expected.
King always uses such powerful words.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, King.
Heard you've been acting like royalty in the sprints lately, too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"That change of direction totally caught me off guard too,
I must say~."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... What is it? You and
Special Week-san are...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Besides, to be completely honest... I thought that daring decisiveness was just unfair.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Sei-chan, King-chan!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Special Week-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I heard you two talking,
so I came over too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: There's something I want to talk to both of you about.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Um, you see...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've gotten stronger than before,
so I want to race with you two again!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just like during last year's Triple Crown campaign!
Let's all compete hard and push each other even—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that a proposal to decide
the leading star of our generation once again?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yup! As expected, King gets it.
It means we're all fighting for the top together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eeeek?! S-Sei-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good, sounds good!
That way seems way more fun anyway~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Let's see. If we add up all three of our specialties and divide by three... medium distance, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Meaning, how about we make the Tenno Sho (Autumn) our battlefield?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...The pinnacle stage for an Umamusume.
A prestigious race where we contend for the autumn shield.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Right. That should be plenty worthy for King too, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's true. It's a noble stage,
fitting for a King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If you all can come there.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Heeh~, look who's talking.
Well, I'm expecting great things too~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The moment I leave King behind
and bolt toward the finish line.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I wonder what their deal is,
those people.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that totally self-centered?
Suddenly coming up and challenging me out of nowhere.
choice_data_list: Just like you, she's a selfish rival.
Just like you, she's a selfish rival, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Mmh...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Am I really that selfish?
I know my limits reasonably well, don't I?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, fine then.
Trainer, about what's next...
choice_data_list: If it's what you want to do, I'll support you.
If it's what you want to do, I'll support you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right. That's just the kind of person you are.
Always thinking about what you should do next for my sake.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I don't dislike that attitude.
